item.title: Ryoujoku★Kazoku System
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Surf
  • 発売日: 2001-09-28
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: 凌辱★家族システム
  • 英語名: Ryoujoku★Kazoku System

あらすじ

On his summer vacation, the main character receives an invitation from a well-known company. The assignment is to choose among four women to play the “mother” and “younger sister” roles, then to live with them in a fake family in the role of the “eldest son”.

The invitation ends with a note that other than murder, everything is allowed…

item.title: Ai Suru Koto ni Reizoku Suru Hito
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Surf
  • 発売日: 2000-12-08
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 愛することに隷属する女
  • 英語名: Ai Suru Koto ni Reizoku Suru Hito

别名

  • 愛隷

あらすじ

Main character lives alone as he does not want to transfer to another school after his father who inherited family business. One day protagonist receives love confession letters from seven girls at the same time. Since each girl’s feelings are strong, he decides to test the limit of their love with the amount of insult that each one can bear…
